clickhouse-disk-usage-high._comment: Escape hatch: disk-used % is (total-free)/total â€” not expressible in the structured query IR. The clickhouse.disks.free_space / clickhouse.disks.total_space metrics are emitted by a custom_queries block in the Datadog ClickHouse check (1-platform/2-monitoring/.../datadog/common/main.tf), tagged with disk_name and kube_cluster_name.

annotations.description: Warn when ClickHouse disk usage exceeds 80%; critical at 90%. Recovery at 75% (warn) / 85% (critical).

datadog.message: ClickHouse disk {{disk_name.name}} on {{host.name}} (cluster {{kube_cluster_name.name}}) has exceeded disk usage thresholds (warn 80%, critical 90%).

clickhouse-disk-usage-high.description: Warn when ClickHouse disk usage exceeds 80%; critical at 90%. Recovery at 75% (warn) / 85% (critical).

clickhouse-ingestion-delay._comment: P1: ingestion delay exceeds SLA â€” delayed inserts building up for 10+ min. clickhouse.query.insert.delayed counts INSERT queries currently queued/delayed due to back-pressure (e.g. max_insert_delay_ms). A sustained non-zero value signals pipeline back-pressure exceeding SLA. For true end-to-end delay (now()-max(event_time)), add a custom_query to main.tf against a known ingestion table. Verified metric name against live agent check.

annotations.description: ClickHouse has delayed INSERT queries â€” back-pressure may be causing ingestion delay exceeding SLA.

datadog.message: ClickHouse on cluster {{kube_cluster_name.name}} has delayed INSERT queries for 10+ minutes. Investigate ingestion pipeline back-pressure.

clickhouse-ingestion-delay.description: ClickHouse has delayed INSERT queries â€” back-pressure may be causing ingestion delay exceeding SLA.

clickhouse-ingestion-slow._comment: P2: minor ingestion slowdown â€” insert row rate slightly below baseline. clickhouse.table.insert.row.total delta over 15m below a threshold indicates a slowdown not yet causing delays. The threshold (rows per 15m window) must be calibrated per environment; placeholder is 50. Verified metric name against live agent check.

annotations.description: ClickHouse insert row rate is running below the expected baseline â€” minor slowdown, not yet at SLA breach. Threshold needs env-specific calibration.

datadog.message: ClickHouse on cluster {{kube_cluster_name.name}} insert rate is below the minor slowdown threshold. No immediate action required but monitor for escalation.

clickhouse-ingestion-slow.description: ClickHouse insert row rate is running below the expected baseline â€” minor slowdown, not yet at SLA breach. Threshold needs env-specific calibration.

clickhouse-no-ingestion._comment: P0: complete ingestion halt â€” no rows inserted for 5 min. clickhouse.table.insert.row.total is a monotonic counter emitted by the standard Datadog ClickHouse integration; .as_count() gives the per-window delta so a zero delta means no rows inserted. Verified against live agent check output on the sandbox.

annotations.description: No rows have been inserted into ClickHouse for 5 minutes â€” possible ingestion pipeline halt.

datadog.message: ClickHouse on cluster {{kube_cluster_name.name}} has had zero row insertions for the past 5 minutes. Check the ingestion pipeline (Kafka consumer, OTel collector, or upstream producers).

clickhouse-no-ingestion.description: No rows have been inserted into ClickHouse for 5 minutes â€” possible ingestion pipeline halt.

clickhouse-write-failures._comment: P0: any insert/write failure. clickhouse.log.messages.error.total is a monotonic counter for all ClickHouse error-level log messages â€” not insert-specific, but the most direct write-failure signal in the standard integration without a custom_query. For a targeted signal, add a custom_query against system.query_log WHERE type='ExceptionBeforeStart' AND query_kind='Insert' to main.tf. Threshold of 0 means any new error triggers. Verified metric name against live agent check.

annotations.description: ClickHouse is logging errors â€” possible insert/write failures. Investigate immediately.

datadog.message: ClickHouse on cluster {{kube_cluster_name.name}} is logging errors. Check system.query_log for insert/write failures.

clickhouse-write-failures.description: ClickHouse is logging errors â€” possible insert/write failures. Investigate immediately.
